purpose: The villain's own shot (U16 carry-in, Trevor order 2026-10-08: people don't care about the hero until they meet the villain). A villain may be a person or NOT a person: cancer, debt, a layoff, a lie, burnout, fear, the inner critic, a system. The shot shows TEXTURE, SCALE, THREAT and the villain's PHYSICAL EFFECT on the hero.
u16_carry_in: The guidance text lives in scripts/core/product_style_bible/bible.py as VILLAIN_SHOT_GUIDANCE (and VILLAIN_LYRIC_GUIDANCE for the Suno side); the assembler reads it from there and never forks it.
camera_default: [Static shot] or a very slow [Push in]
emotion_rule: The fear, weight or dread reads on the hero's body, not in a grimace. A pain line never gets a smile. The villain's own shot never softens it.
beats_pattern: the villain fills the frame -> the threat lands (texture, scale) -> the hero's body answers (breath, posture, hands, light on the face)
